page.overview:
Who is Wooky?

Wooky sports a green jacket and plants plus yellow hood, gloves and boots.

Wooky is the most frequently appearing enemy type, though there is also a less common variant which rides mechs known as Ride Armors.

Akiman's unfinished Captain Commando manga depicts Wooky having enough physical strength to crush an adult man's head with his hands.

Wooky appears as an enemy in Project X Zone 2 alongside other Captain Commando foes.
